scope: Illustrative design previews only; not production acceptance

checks.name: afavers-workspace.html: fragment and size contract
Desktop initial list and inspector
DM Sans and Manrope have explicit roles and no initial animation
Detail selection moves only the selected content and cancels superseded motion
Search and no-results recovery
Remote filter and source filter
Built-in saved search and no email implication
Create and reuse a named search
Save and saved-list filtering
Shared detail preparation, private draft and activity
Apply is honest and does not submit
Hide and undo restore the example
Dashboard agenda and stage navigation
All nine application statuses remain available
Non-drag application transition and measured move wiring
Settings appearance and alert boundary
Tweak bindings update real preview state
Reduced-motion selection keeps current details without movement
Motion source has bounded spatial effects without opacity fades
Focus alternative uses list then full details
Visible desktop buttons have accessible text or labels
Incoming host review state restores a validated screen
afavers-phone.html: fragment and size contract
Phone has one contained layout and complete local navigation
Phone board is stage-focused and can open preparation
Proposed text-token contrast pairs meet 4.5 to 1
No unhandled script exceptions during interactions

limitations: Built-in browser security rejected the file protocol. No protocol workaround or alternate browser was used.

Offline jsdom checks use explicit viewport/geometry/media-query stubs; they test motion scheduling, cancellation and reduced-motion wiring, but do not measure layout, overflow, first-result height, CSS/font rendering, actual animation smoothness, focus visibility or touch geometry.
The host variant carousel and Tweak bindings follow the documented contract; actual host rendering is available in the conversation but was not browser-inspected by the agent.
No live API, database, account, email, build, deployment or production behavior was exercised.

resources.retained: Durable mockup fragments, optional rendered inspection copies, verification script/results and OpenSpec planning documents.
